h1: Grand Marina Residence Hotel — a residence hotel in Laem Chabang close to both Kasetsart and the industrial estate
intro: Anyone who has to work, run errands, or send their kids to school around Si Racha-Laem Chabang knows that good, affordable accommodation here isn't easy to find, since most options are monthly dorms or small hotels with little online information — Grand Marina Residence Hotel is one of the choices that real guests speak well of · It's a 3-star residence hotel in Thung Sukhla near Ao Udom, with spacious rooms that include a fridge and a desk, good for both a single night and a longer work stay · It has a pool, a fitness room, and free parking · It sits near Kasetsart University Si Racha campus, Ao Udom market, and the Laem Chabang industrial estate · From about ฿750/night, rated 8.5 from 48 reviews on Trip.com

body.html: If you're naming the parts of Chonburi that business and work travelers pass through most often, Si Racha-Laem Chabang is near the top of the list, since it's a port town, an industrial zone, and home to several universities and international schools · But when it comes to finding good, affordable accommodation here, there are fewer options with clear online information than you'd expect, because most are monthly dorms or small guesthouses that aren't on the big booking platforms · Grand Marina Residence Hotel is one of the names real guests speak well of, because it positions itself as a residence hotel that sits between a hotel and an apartment, meaning you get the convenience of a hotel (a reception desk, staff on hand) and the roominess of a residence-style unit with a fridge and a desk you'll actually use · It's on Soi Sawasdee in Thung Sukhla subdistrict, Si Racha district, near Ao Udom and the Laem Chabang industrial estate

Before getting into the details, let's be straight: this review is put together from the voices of real guests across several platforms — Trip.com, Booking.com, Agoda, and Wongnai — plus the information the hotel publishes itself, not from staying here ourselves · The overall picture is "a genuinely practical, well-located place at a friendly price" that leans on value and cleanliness more than luxury · Its Trip.com score sits at 8.5 out of 10 from 48 reviews, with the highest-rated category being service (around 9.0), followed by cleanliness and facilities · The thing to understand from the start is that this isn't a beachfront resort that brings you here to relax and take in the view — it's an in-town hotel designed mainly for the convenience of people with business in Si Racha-Laem Chabang

The overall picture and who it suits — Grand Marina Residence Hotel suits workers coming to do business at the Laem Chabang industrial estate and port who want accommodation close to work, with parking, at a price that won't balloon over several nights in a row · The second group is parents and relatives visiting students at Kasetsart University Si Racha campus, which is a few minutes' drive away · The third group is travelers driving the Bang Na-Trat route or the motorway who want somewhere to overnight nearby before continuing on to Pattaya, Rayong, or the islands · And there's the group who want a semi-residential short stay, since the rooms have a fridge and enough space to live in · On the flip side, if you've come to enjoy Chonburi's sea with the beach right at your door, or you're after a resort feel for a honeymoon, this may not be the right fit, because it's an in-town hotel that emphasizes function over views and atmosphere · Setting your expectations correctly from the start makes a clear difference in how happy you'll be here

Location and getting around is the main reason people choose to stay here · The hotel is at 224/65 Moo 8, Soi Sawasdee, Thung Sukhla subdistrict, Si Racha district, in the Ao Udom side of Laem Chabang · Its strong point is being "within easy reach of everything you need" — Ao Udom market is about 1 km away, the Laem Chabang sports field and the Si Racha public library are within a 1.5 km radius, and there are 7-Eleven convenience stores and made-to-order eateries within walking distance, which many reviews praise as very handy when you're hungry late at night · Kasetsart University Si Racha campus is about a 4-5 min drive away, and the Space Inspirium museum (a space technology learning center) is about a 6 min drive · For workers, the Laem Chabang industrial estate and port are a short drive away as well · Driving from Bangkok takes about an hour and a half to two hours via the motorway or Sukhumvit Road, and the hotel has free private parking on site, plus an EV charging point that isn't often found in accommodation at this price · One thing to note is that without your own car, getting around this area is harder than in a tourist town, since public transport isn't frequent — be ready to call a taxi or use a ride-hailing app, and check that cars can reach the property before you set off
"Clean room, the receptionist was lovely, close to 7-Eleven and restaurants, and there's a pool and a fitness room too. Parking is easy. Great value for this area."

Room types and decor — the hotel has around 25 air-conditioned rooms, split into a few main types to keep the choice simple · It starts with the Standard Double Bed Room, a large-bed room for couples or solo travelers who want a wider bed · the Standard 2 Single Bed Room, a twin-bed room good for colleagues or anyone who prefers separate beds · and the Deluxe 2 Single Bed Room, a twin-bed room that's a bit larger and slightly better appointed · The decor is a simple, contemporary style in light tones, focused on being easy to use rather than on bold design · What sets this place apart from hotels at a similar price is that every room has a full residence-style set of amenities — a fridge, work desk, electric kettle, clothes rail, hairdryer, and bathroom amenities · Many reviews agree the rooms are roomier than expected at this price, and some have a built-in dining table, so you can buy food from the market or 7-Eleven and eat comfortably in your room · A frequent compliment is the comfortable bed and cold air-conditioning, which are important basics for anyone here on a work trip who needs a full night's sleep · Free Wi-Fi is in every room and the common areas, and for anyone who has to take online meetings or work in their room it does the job · One thing to know is that these are practical, working rooms — they aren't focused on pretty views or wide balconies, so the decor is plainer than a boutique hotel, but you get clear value in return

Facilities and the pool — for a hotel at this price, Grand Marina Residence gives you more facilities than you'd expect · There's an outdoor pool for a cooling dip after work or in the evening, and a fitness room with enough equipment that regular exercisers don't have to drop their routine · There's a ping-pong table to pass the time, and bicycle rental for riding around the area · On the service side there's a reception desk and free luggage storage, which helps a lot when you arrive before check-in time or have to check out but still have errands in town · There's an EV charging point on site, free private parking, and free Wi-Fi throughout · One thing that has to be said plainly is that some reviews flag the pool, noting that at times it may be closed for maintenance or not quite match all the promotional photos · So if being able to use the pool is a key factor in your decision, you should call the hotel directly before booking to confirm the pool will be open and running normally during your stay · Overall, the facilities you can count on are the fitness room, the parking, and the common areas, while the pool should be treated as a bonus to confirm first

Food and dining — the hotel has an in-house restaurant and breakfast service for guests, but its real dining strength is the location more than the hotel kitchen · Because the hotel is surrounded by a residential neighborhood and is close to Ao Udom market, a short walk or drive turns up made-to-order eateries, rice shops, noodle shops, coffee shops, and convenience stores everywhere · Many reviews praise having a 7-Eleven and restaurants within walking distance as a big advantage, especially for people who finish work late and want an easy bite · Ao Udom market, about 1 km away, is a popular food spot for locals here, with seafood, ready-made dishes, desserts, and inexpensive goods, ideal for taking back to a room with a fridge · For anyone on a longer work stay, having a fridge and a desk in the room plus a market and convenience stores nearby saves a lot on food compared with eating out every meal · That said, the hotel is an alcohol-free property, so anyone expecting a bar or drinks at the hotel should know that in advance

Service is this hotel's highest-rated category in real reviews, sitting at around 9.0 out of 10 on Trip.com · The reception staff are mentioned very often as friendly, smiling, and helpful, whether it's recommending restaurants, giving directions, or sorting out parking · For a small hotel of around 25 rooms, the team being able to look after guests thoroughly is an advantage, because guests feel more personally cared for than at a big, busy hotel · The reception is open 24 hours and offers free luggage storage, so people who arrive late or have flights or appointments at odd hours can manage their own schedule easily · To be straight, since it's a small hotel, some extra services that big hotels have — like overnight room service or a full concierge — may not be as complete, but in terms of attention to each guest, this place does well, and that's a strength that brings people back

Voices from real reviews (praise and gripes) — gathered from Trip.com, Booking.com, Agoda, and Wongnai, and the picture is fairly consistent · On the praise side: the rooms are clean and roomier than the price suggests, the bed is comfortable and the air-conditioning is cold, the reception staff are friendly and the service is very good, the location is close to 7-Eleven, restaurants, and Ao Udom market, there's free parking and an EV charging point, the fridge and desk in the room make it comfortable in a residence-style way, and the price is great value for the Laem Chabang-Si Racha area · Many reviews note that over the past several months there have been almost no negative comments at all · On the gripes side: the thing that comes up is the pool, where at times the condition or opening doesn't match the promotional photos — check before booking if you intend to use it · Next is the location, which, though convenient for those with a car, is harder to reach for those without one because it's in an industrial-town area rather than a tourist zone, the surroundings are a community and working streets rather than sea views, and it's a small hotel with limited luxury facilities · Most of these gripes are about setting your expectations to match the type of hotel, rather than problems that keep people from coming back
"Big room with a dining table inside, close to 7-Eleven and restaurants, a full pool and fitness room, and the staff service is very good. Great for a work stay around Laem Chabang."

Price comparison and value — the starting price for a Standard room is about ฿750/night in the regular range (around USD 22-29 as shown on many platforms), and it nudges up a little for the Deluxe room or during periods with events at the industrial estate and high room demand · Compared with other hotels and residences in the Laem Chabang-Si Racha area, this price is great value, especially counting the spacious room with a fridge and desk, free parking, a pool, and a fitness room, at a price several times lower than chain hotels of the same standard · The best value is for people staying several nights in a row to work in this area, because the longer you stay, the clearer the value from having a small kitchen of sorts and a market nearby — the nightly rate works out far cheaper than hotels in Pattaya or on the seafront side of Si Racha · For anyone here for a single night while traveling, the price is still light for what you get · The only caveat is that if you weight views and a resort atmosphere more than function, the value from that angle drops, because this place sells convenience and price, not atmosphere

Things to know before booking — a few things help make the stay smoother · One, if you intend to use the pool, you should call the hotel directly before booking to confirm it will be open and running normally during your stay, since reviews have flagged this · Two, this place suits people with a car more; if you don't have one, plan your transport from town or the airport in advance, and check whether app-hailed cars can reach the Soi Sawasdee area · Three, the rooms have a fridge and a desk, good for a semi-residential stay — for a longer stay, swing by Ao Udom market or 7-Eleven and stock up in your room to save money and time · Four, the hotel is an alcohol-free property, so anyone expecting a hotel bar should be prepared · Five, check-in is from 2:00 PM, check-out before 12:00 PM, and there's free luggage storage if you arrive early or need to move on after checking out · Six, since it's a small hotel of around 25 rooms, rooms may fill up fast during events at the industrial estate or university activities, so book ahead and compare prices across several platforms · The hotel contact number listed in the information is 038-352226, in case you want to ask about room or pool details before booking

The bottom line — Grand Marina Residence Hotel isn't a luxury beachfront resort, and it isn't trying to be one · It's a genuinely practical, well-located residence hotel in the Laem Chabang-Si Racha area, best suited to workers at the industrial estate and port, parents visiting students at Kasetsart Si Racha, and travelers looking for good-value accommodation in this area · Its strengths are spacious, residence-style rooms with a fridge and a desk, friendly service that earns it the highest scores, a location close to convenience stores, Ao Udom market, and Kasetsart, plus free parking and an EV charging point, at a price starting in the high hundreds per night · The points to set your expectations on are the pool, which you should check first, the in-town setting rather than a sea view, and transport that's more convenient for those with a car · If your brief is clean, good-value accommodation close to what you need to reach in Si Racha-Laem Chabang rather than a seaside getaway, Grand Marina Residence is one of the most sensible, best-value bases in this area
